messages.subject: latent regression in mirt
parts:
HI Phil

I am doing a simulation with R and applied 'mirt' for latent regression estimation. when i run my simulation some warnings are emerged. do you have any solution for these warnings? 
can i use mixedmirt() for my simulation instead of mirt to handle warnings?  


EM cycles terminated after 500 iterations.

Warning messages:
1: Log-likelihood was decreasing near the ML solution. EM method may be unstable 
2: Log-likelihood was decreasing near the ML solution. EM method may be unstable 
3: Log-likelihood was decreasing near the ML solution. EM method may be unstable

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: latent regression in mirt
parts:
For the first warning I would probably not use that fitted model and instead re-draw the data. The logical extract.mirt(mod, 'converged') is useful here to test whether the model terminated successfully. The second warning is innocuous and can generally be ignored.  

Phil
